opportunities.name: SEO Beginner Journey Research
opportunities.nextAction: Map how SEO beginners move between AI assistants, Google, tutorials, communities and SEO tools; identify repeated moments where they do not know the next step, which tool to use, or what to observe. Use this evidence to shape Guides and Guided Workflows.

opportunities.name: Keyword Research Workflow
opportunities.nextAction: Methodology is validated. Next validate the beginner-facing guided flow manually: Guide -> Open -> Observe -> Done -> Next. Test whether Side Panel guidance, progress and return-to-open-tab behavior are materially better than isolated Templates without bulk-opening tools.

opportunities.name: Competitor Research Workflow
opportunities.nextAction: Separate SEO competitor research from broader market/ads research, then validate which beginner decisions need guidance and which recurring browser actions SEOJump can actually accelerate.

opportunities.name: Backlink Research Workflow
opportunities.nextAction: Find direct evidence for a repeated multi-tool backlink workflow; current evidence mainly validates backlink tools, not a workflow launcher.

opportunities.name: SEO Audit Workflow
opportunities.nextAction: Investigate because recent practitioner discussion explicitly asks for fixed audit workflows and tool stacks.

opportunities.name: Get more from free and existing SEO tools
opportunities.nextAction: Use as a demand cluster, not a product boundary; quantify recurring tasks where users combine free/freemium/paid tools manually.

opportunities.name: AI Search / GEO Tool Radar
opportunities.nextAction: Test recent products for stable deep links and SEOJump context compatibility before adding templates.

opportunities.name: AI-ready Workflow Layer
opportunities.nextAction: Do not prototype now. Revisit only after the simple beginner browser Workflow has demonstrated real usage and a concrete need for MCP/API/AI executors.

opportunities.name: SEOJump Hosted SEO Agent
opportunities.nextAction: Do not build while SEOJump's workflow layer and differentiated value remain unvalidated; re-evaluate only if users repeatedly request one integrated agent experience.

opportunities.name: Automate public free SEO tools as an agent data backend
opportunities.nextAction: Keep free-tool deep links for browser use; do not rely on scraping/bot automation of public Ahrefs-style tools as product infrastructure.
